headerDisplay: Controls a Visonic panel through the ConnectAlarm account. Home sets Stay, Away sets Away, Night sets Night, and Off disarms the panel.

host.title: PowerManage host
host.description: Server address from the ConnectAlarm app, without https://.

panelSerial.title: Panel serial
panelSerial.description: Panel ID from ConnectAlarm. This is the integration identification number, not the printed serial number.

userCode.title: Master user code
userCode.description: The master code used to arm and disarm the panel.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: A stable UUID for this Homebridge install. Leave blank to generate one on first launch.

partition.title: Partition
partition.description: Use -1 for the whole panel, or a partition number such as 1.

profile.title: Panel profile
profile.description: ConnectAlarm sends Stay, Away, and Night. PowerMaster sends Home and Away.

nightArm.title: Night mode
nightArm.description: Used only for a PowerMaster profile. ConnectAlarm has its own Night state.
